unit: One distinct report, case-study publication, research experiment or mathematical preprint. Not one test, repository, independent defect, media asset or repost.

Zenodo: 79 individual records plus one historical 45-report collection. The collection does not add45 new reports and is excluded from the90 individual-publication union.
The owner-filtered Zenodo query covers80 public latest-version records with80 distinct concept identifiers. Search hits by other Kadirbekovs are excluded.
Several case-study publications revisit or combine the same underlying defects. No independent-defect total is asserted.
